Fatties misunderstand what metabolism means. Metabolism is like speed; it is just a number that represents how much energy is being burnt. It is not, contrary to popular belief, a mystical force that requires ritual sacrifice or magic to appease. My car travels at 60 km/h and my body burns, on average, 50 calories/hour. That is metabolic rate.

The confusing part for fatties is between metabolic rate and basal metabolic rate. Basal metabolic rate can be inherently high or low. This is the one that cundishuns affect. Metabolism otherwise, however, is within our control: Sit on the couch for an hour, you'll probably burn around that 50 calorie mark; walk for an hour, you'll probably burn more like 200-300 calories; run for an hour, you'll burn more like 500-600 calories. Different activities demand differing amounts of energy and the changing demand affects the speed at which energy is burnt, i.e. metabolism. Over the course of a day, a higher energy expenditure means the average metabolic rate is higher.

Not only that, fat, muscle, and organs burn energy. Fat burns around 4 calories/pound/day and muscle burns around 6 calories/pound/day just in maintenance. The irony is that fats have raging metabolisms because all that fat needs energy in maintenance. Again, though, these factors are within control. Increase muscle, increase movement, increase metabolism.
